2026_02_MIN_CHI.headline: Minnesota’s depleted offense meets Chicago’s fast-starting attack
2026_02_MIN_CHI.paragraph1: Minnesota heads to Soldier Field without Kyler Murray and Jauan Jennings, while right tackle Brian O’Neill is questionable, putting more strain on the Vikings’ protection and replacement passing plan. Chicago returns home after an explosive opening win and will try to keep Caleb Williams in favorable early-down situations. The Bears can make Minnesota chase the game by sustaining that balance; the Vikings need their defense to disrupt Chicago early and keep the score within a structure their short-handed offense can manage.
2026_02_MIN_CHI.model_rationale: Minnesota’s protection and replacement passing plan must withstand Chicago’s pressure while the Vikings defense prevents Caleb Williams from operating comfortably on favorable early downs.
